title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
snippet: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: ESMA warns growing crypto ties could amplify risks to traditional finance
snippet: The EU securities regulator flagged tokenized equities, DeFi exploits and prediction markets as areas where growing crypto ties could pose risks to the broader financial system.

title: UK House of Lords backs mandatory digital asset strategy over Labour position
snippet: The amendment would require the UK Treasury to develop a strategy covering cryptoassets, stablecoins, tokenized securities and digital financial infrastructure.

title: EU finance groups push to remove tokenized securities cap
snippet: European finance and tokenization groups say Brussels should remove limits on assets admitted to DLT infrastructure or set a 1.5 trillion euro baseline if a cap remains.

title: Bitcoin falls on US PPI overshoot as 30-year bond yield hits new 19-year high
snippet: Bitcoin fell with US stocks as high inflation and a further surge in oil prices coincided with another multidecade high for US bond yields.

title: Solana sees record 263K tokens issued in a single day
snippet: Memecoin platform Pump.fun accounted for most of the new tokens among launchpads, as the Solana network notched a new all-time daily issuance high.

title: Treasury Secretary Bessent urges CLARITY Act passage after Senate returns
snippet: Secretary Scott Bessent warned that failing to pass the CLARITY Act would send a “troubling signal” about America’s leadership in the digital asset industry.

title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $167M after strongest three-week inflow run of 2026
snippet: ARKB led Wednesday’s Bitcoin ETF outflows as Ether and Solana funds returned to net inflows.

title: Bitcoin sell-side risk returns to rare lows as $80K sellers fade from view
snippet: Bitcoin investors showed little sign of panic selling as BTC held most of its August gains and sell-side risk fell to rare lows, data showed.

title: Trezor, BitBox warn users about fake hardware wallet security alerts
snippet: BitBox said multiple Bitcoin companies appeared to have been targeted through a shared newsletter provider, while Trezor confirmed a breach at its email service.

title: Bitcoin fails to reclaim $80K as Bessent fuels yen strength around 153 per dollar
snippet: Bitcoin trended lower with US stocks on Iran escalation while US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent contributed to fears of a yen carry-trade unwind.
